There are rumors that they have ties to more powerful criminal organizations, and that they are merely one tendril of that vast galactic conglomeration of crime.

A man with a reputation for knowing where the interesting things are.

Harry Mason is a man known about Veles as having an enduring hatred of the Mandalorians. Word on the street is that he lost his home back during the Mandalorian War, and that grudge he had nursed since then.

One of the many survivors of the Mandalorian Wars who have come to settle in Veles over the years, Orlando is known to be rather vocal about his distrust towards the Mandalorians. While most clans passing through only receive furtive glares, he has seen to have taken particular interest in the group that’s holed up the old wildwoods facility.
A former member of Czerka’s ‘Refugees Care Foundation’, Szaan has since joined the Velesian Government proper to continue his work with community outreach, assisting citizens and visitors alike.

An older looking, slightly reclusive Trandoshan woman decked out in rugged leathers and cloth that compliment sandy coloured scales and yellow eyes. Irene works odd jobs in Veles, and seems well connected with the Deputy Tal’gar Meyne.

From a carbon chisel to a pinch-jack, all the way to a plasmatorch and magna-driver, this mechanic is one of those responsible for the maintenance of the taxis and the taxi terminals. A few grease smears on her clothes and hands. She seems to be having trouble keeping up with repairs.

Moira Halaz, one of many of the Veles residents, takes care of supply runs out to the various remote outposts around Viscara. She’s been plagued by the local wildlife as of late, and her distraught expression betrays that trouble is never too far away.

Tal'gar Meyne serves as one of Sheriff’s Deputies in Veles, though his responsibilities tend to focus outside the city walls; dealing with threats from the wildwoods or Mandalorian bandits that may have decided to threaten the security of the colony.

Roy has a reputation as a man who knows where to get things that people really want; and not always through legal means. A rugged looking twi’lek with a blaster worn readily on his hip, and a charismatic confidence.
Description: A shady man who doesn’t seem interested in talking to you. He conceals his identity while constantly looking over his shoulders for anyone who might be staring at him too long.

Prior to the Viscaran buyout, many refugees had fled to Veles to find themselves homeless. Krystalle frequently cared for their wellbeing, with a scathing hatred for Czerka Corporation for their apathetic nature towards the refugees in years prior.

Now, she helps organize the colony’s defenses, working closely with the Sheriff’s Department as one of many on-call couriers. Where she once dedicated her time to arming the colonists within Veles to be able to defend themselves, she now aids in arming the rest of the colonists.

Czerka has a sizable security force, the Czerka Ranger Corps. Private security, mercenaries and bounty hunters flock to it, eager for the generous pay Czerka employees are known to receive. It works well for them, so long as they remember - don’t cross Czerka, and "no questions asked" means "no questions asked."

These Czerka Rangers are largely responsible for maintaining law and order outside the city of Veles, where the Sheriff’s Office handles internal affairs, and they toe a careful line between enforcing company policy while ensuring that any resentment amongst the colonists does not grow out of control. In some ways, the Czerka Rangers of Veles therefore need to be almost as much diplomats and friendly beat cops as much as soldiers.

Tasers can be used to incapacitate living creatures, or fuse the circuits of droids.

These small droids are widespread.  The term "utility droid" is used for many different models that vary widely in form and function. Some of them, particularly the Duwani Mechanicals models, were at times referred as "astromech droids." 

Some models are used for advanced applied physics functions such as starship repair, astrogation, and even computer slicing and programming. Others perform more menial tasks such as janitorial duties and waste disposal.

MART WEBBER

A dedicated champion for the people.

A proud Mandalorian, a man of honor.

A loving father.

Former Veles Councilman; a face of the colony.

He fought and bled countless times to protect Veles and its people.

He is remembered as a beacon of hope and liberty, one who carried far more than his share for far longer than any could ask.
----------------
OOC:
In loving memory of Jacob - known to us as Webber. He was a good friend and a pillar of our community, always helpful to newcomers and a beloved part of what makes SWLOR special. 

He was a brilliant writer, expressive and intriguing, kind, and able to share his creativity with dozens of people from all over the world. It was a loving pleasure and honor to have known such a loving person and it is with great regret that we will not see what future he could have brought for the world.

He is and will always be missed.

On occasion, the door may occasionally require a bit of a shove - scrap tossed about from various projects often needed to be swept up. An engineer's dream workshop, the space offers all the tools one would need, and friendly chatter all the while.

A meticulously organized hall, bodies hustling about with datapads of blueprints and designs. An underappreciated trade some may say, but a Fabricator knows their worth - the door would slide open with an impressive smoothness - its the little things you don't notice until they're screeching for oil.

Heat emanates from this building, no doubt from the multiple forges within that rotated through regular use. Open to new and experienced smiths alike, one's skills are encouraged to be whet, here. Some might complain about the noise, but the folks inside probably wouldn't hear the yelling.
Workers bustle about during the prime hours of the day. Even Chef Master Yu can be seen here from time to time overseeing the project.
